description: Digital Technology explains how digital devices, software and the internet work — digital safety and the Cyber Chip, compression and networks, apps and malware, productivity tools, digital projects for your troop, intellectual property, e-waste, and careers.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Digital safety
requirements.summary: The Personal Safety Awareness “Digital Safety” video and the Cyber Chip.

requirements.title: History and future
requirements.summary: How digital technology has changed over time and may change in the future.

requirements.title: How devices work
requirements.summary: Digitizing media, compression, programming, and local and wide area networks.

requirements.title: Software and security
requirements.summary: How apps run, malware and protecting against it, and barcodes, QR codes and RFID.

requirements.title: The internet and productivity
requirements.summary: How data moves online, secure connections, and using productivity software for troop tasks.

requirements.title: Digital projects
requirements.summary: Projects for your troop such as photos, audio recordings and a blog.

requirements.title: Intellectual property
requirements.summary: Copyright, patents, trademarks and trade secrets, and using software legally.

requirements.title: Disposal and recycling
requirements.summary: Options on safely disposing of and recycling electronics and batteries.

requirements.title: Careers
requirements.summary: One option: researching a career or visiting a facility that uses digital technology.
